usedFor: LinkedIn Campaign Manager captures leads and Brevo keeps contacts: “New Sponsored Lead Form Response” runs “Add Contacts To List”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sponsored Lead Form Response” in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: Ad leads land on a Brevo list right away for follow-up emails.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” adds existing contacts, so a new lead needs a Brevo contact first.
